subject.title: [Feature]: Telegram onboarding: offer BotFather web app flow next to the chat flow

question: Should OpenClaw accept the linked narrow docs/wizard BotFather Mini App pointer now, or hold this issue for a fuller Telegram managed-bot onboarding direction?
rationale: The requested change is a user-facing onboarding addition with a protected `maintainer` label and an open linked PR, so cleanup automation should not close it or create a competing repair branch.

options.title: Review the linked narrow PR
options.body: Accept or request changes on the open PR that only adds the official BotFather Mini App pointer to wizard help and docs, while keeping managed-bot provisioning out of scope.

options.title: Hold for a broader Telegram setup design
options.body: Keep the issue open for a product decision on managed-bot provisioning, token custody, and multi-account setup shape before changing onboarding copy.

options.title: Decline the extra setup pointer
options.body: Close the issue and linked PR if maintainers decide the classic chat-command BotFather flow should remain the only documented setup path.

recommendation.title: Review the linked narrow PR
recommendation.body: Accept or request changes on the open PR that only adds the official BotFather Mini App pointer to wizard help and docs, while keeping managed-bot provisioning out of scope.

likelyOwner.reason: Current source history and the issue/PR context both point to steipete as the closest routing owner for this onboarding/docs choice.
